description: Catalog of runtime scenarios the pack's orchestration must handle correctly, per the mission's completion checklist. This JSON is the DEFINITION (id, category, description, expected outcome contract) — mirroring the gate definition/engine split, the actual executable implementation of each scenario lives in tests/evaluations.test.mjs, keyed by id, so 'evaluation' here means a real automated check against real runtime code, not a decorative description. Run: `node --test tests/evaluations.test.mjs`.

scenarios.description: A new project with no product code — the greenfield workflow builds a valid, acyclic execution graph.
scenarios.expected: graph builds; nodes cover discovery through closure

scenarios.description: A bounded change to an existing project — the brownfield-change workflow builds a valid graph covering discovery through closure.
scenarios.expected: graph builds; nodes cover discovery through closure

scenarios.description: A schema/data migration — the migration workflow requires an approval-gated safety-review phase before expand/backfill.
scenarios.expected: safety-review phase has approvalRequired: true and precedes expand

scenarios.description: A live incident — the incident workflow's root-cause-and-prevention phase is the terminal completion gate.
Recovering after an interruption/failure — the recovery workflow re-anchors before resuming forward progress.
scenarios.expected: re-anchor phase has no dependencies; resume depends transitively on it

scenarios.description: A release/deploy — the release workflow requires an approval-gated deploy phase before production-validation.
scenarios.expected: deploy phase has approvalRequired: true and precedes production-validation

scenarios.description: A side-effect that failed midway — completion-gate.mjs must not pass while an unreconciled DESTRUCTIVE/EXTERNAL_WRITE effect exists without a recovery-plan.
scenarios.expected: an unreconciled EXTERNAL_WRITE effect with no recovery-plan is flagged

scenarios.description: Evidence recorded, then the workspace changes — completion-gate.mjs must BLOCK on the now-stale evidence rather than accept it.
scenarios.expected: gate status BLOCKED citing stale/missing fresh evidence

scenarios.description: Two agents propose incompatible canonical decisions for the same subject — a conflict-record must exist and block until resolved by a decision-record.
scenarios.expected: conflict OPEN blocks; RESOLVED after a linked decision-record exists

scenarios.description: A mission is interrupted mid-way (context compaction) — mission state on disk must be sufficient to reconstruct open work without re-running discovery.
scenarios.expected: state.json alone yields correct open-criteria/open-findings counts

scenarios.description: A required gate script genuinely fails — completion-gate.mjs --run-gates must report BLOCKED with the specific gate's failure, not a false PASS.
scenarios.expected: gate status BLOCKED citing the specific failing gate

scenarios.description: A recovery-plan exists for a side effect — executing it and reconciling the effect must be independently verifiable from records alone.
scenarios.expected: side-effect-record.reconciled becomes true only after a linked, executed recovery-plan

scenarios.description: A contract crosses to a non-owned external consumer — this cannot be treated as freely correctable on both sides the way an internal contract is.
scenarios.expected: external contracts are schema-distinguishable (category D) from internal ones (category C)

scenarios.description: A schema change must go through expand-migrate-contract, not an in-place rename, per data-governance.md.
scenarios.expected: schema-normalization skill's sequence is expand before contract, never combined

scenarios.description: A producer/consumer pair disagree on a shared contract's shape — this must be raised as a finding, not silently tolerated.
scenarios.expected: a contract mismatch is representable as a category C/D finding with evidenceIds

scenarios.description: Two proposed canonical names for the same concept — the canonical-map-entry schema and conflict/decision records together resolve this to exactly one entry.
scenarios.expected: canonical-map-entry has exactly one 'application' name per concept after a decision resolves the conflict

scenarios.description: A CRITICAL/HIGH security finding exists — completion-gate.mjs must BLOCK regardless of every other check passing.
scenarios.expected: gate status BLOCKED citing the undisposed finding

scenarios.description: An L5 release-touching mission with no production-validation-record (or one that's FAILED) — the release workflow's completion condition is not met.
scenarios.expected: release.json completionConditions require a HEALTHY or OUT_OF_SCOPE production-validation-record
